description: FREE and read-only. Fetch the stored result of a paid call (or its current status, e.g. completed or failed) using the request_id and result_token from the original response. Use it instead of paying again when an answer was lost. Results are deleted 30 days after the call; an expired result returns an 'expired' error. Retrieval never charges and never triggers a new data call.

request_id.description: The request_id from the original paid response (a UUID, e.g. 3f2b8c1e-...).

result_token.description: The secret result_token returned with that response (about 32 characters). Without it the result is not shown.

name: get_result
